Definition: from the base of G3674; similar (in appearance or character):--like, + manner.
BiblicalUsage: hómoios — like, similar. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 41 occurrences, and in Matthew, Luke, John, and Acts the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hómoios matters because we are made in God’s likeness, and Christ restores what sin broke. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
RelatedEvents: The Children in the Marketplace; The Sermon on the Mount; The Wise and Foolish Builders
